title: D-087 3D-1: deterministic massing model - lot + proposed building as a versioned structured-geometry object (declared CRS/units/local origin, closed triangulated meshes, floor plates, metrics, provenance) per the 3D architecture truth model (module + tests; no route, no UI)
objective: Build services/api/app/scenario/massing_model.py: the canonical scenario-geometry object of docs/3D_MASSING_ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE.md (sections 2-4 and 10, subset) from (a) the canonical EPSG:2263 lot ring, (b) a proposal footprint ring + floor stack (per-floor heights) read through the accepted B0 proposal contract (app/scenario/proposal.py / contract.py, read-only), and optionally (c) a generated building option in the max-envelope engine's as_dict shape: declared CRS, horizontal/vertical units, axis order, local-origin transform and precision grid; layers parcel / proposed_massing / generated_option; closed prisms per floor band with consistent outward winding (ear-clipping triangulation that handles concave rings); per-floor plates with areas from the 2263 ring; metrics (gross floor area, total height); provenance (input digests, generator_version 'massing-1.0.0'); the section-10 quality checks as typed refusals.
business_reason: The owner released 3D building-and-lot handling (D-087-R003); the architecture requires a deterministic geometry truth object BEFORE any renderer - this is the server-side foundation every 3D view and the AutoCAD export consume.

KNOWN BROKER LIMIT: documented commands may be runnable only from the worktree root - route blocked runs to harvest with an exact recipe, never predict-as-observed.

ZERO NEW DEPENDENCIES (binding; D-087-R009 + the dependency-security policy): stdlib plus already-admitted packages only (shapely/numpy/pydantic/fastapi are admitted); no lockfile or requirements change; no network access in code or tests.

HONESTY (binding; D-073-R006/D-076-R002/D-083 vocabulary): proposal-derived geometry is 'Proposed - not a city record'; a generated option is a 'Generated building option'; nothing is ever labeled permitted, approved, or 'maximum allowed building'; no legal conclusion is drawn.

Three.js is NOT in scope; the object is renderer-agnostic JSON.

FAIL-CLOSED (binding, D-051): a footprint not within the lot beyond a declared tolerance is refused 'footprint_outside_lot' - never clipped silently; holes, self-intersection, non-finite values, over-cap vertex counts, zero/negative heights each a typed refusal; the generated option is accepted only in the engine's exact as_dict shape (mirror, never guess).

TESTS + MUTATION (binding): rectangle, L-shape (concave) and a 5-floor stack - every prism closed (each edge shared by exactly two faces), outward orientation (signed volume > 0), no degenerate triangle, triangulated cap area == polygon area, volume == area x height within 1e-9 relative; plate areas match shapely's 2263 area; mutation: swapping two floor heights or reversing one winding reddens a named test.

CODE-GRAPH NAVIGATION BLOCK (D-066-R001; graph REGENERATED at this contract seam: 815 files/17025 nodes/7441 edges): app/scenario/max_envelope.py (998 SLOC, FORBIDDEN - read its as_dict shape only), app/scenario/proposal.py + contract.py (the B0 proposal contract - read-only), app/connectors/mappluto_geometry_arcgis.py (canonical 2263 ring - read-only). massing_model.py is NEW; nothing imports it yet. Run `python tools/code_graph/query.py --no-regen impact <path>` before sweeps; graph ADVISORY - verify every material conclusion in actual source.

DISCOVERY ROUTING (D-069, binding): out-of-scope product/domain/defect findings go in the report's DISCOVERIES section - never fixed in-packet; the orchestrator records them in docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md at the seam.
outputs: services/api/app/scenario/massing_model.py - the versioned massing truth object + builders + typed refusals
services/api/tests/scenario/test_massing_model.py - mesh-closure, orientation, area/volume, plate, provenance and refusal tests
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (truth object): the output declares CRS EPSG:2263, US-survey-foot horizontal and vertical units, axis order, the local origin and its exact transform, precision grid, generator_version and input digests; it is JSON-serializable and deterministic (golden sha256).

AS-2 (mesh correctness): for rectangle, concave L-shape and a 5-floor stack every prism is closed, outward-oriented and free of degenerate triangles; cap triangulation area equals the polygon area; mutation - reversing one face winding reddens a named test.

AS-3 (plates + metrics): per-floor plate areas equal the 2263 footprint area; gross floor area = the sum of plates; total height = the sum of floor heights; mutation - swapping two floor heights reddens.

AS-4 (fail-closed): footprint outside the lot, holes, self-intersection, non-finite values, over-cap vertices and non-positive heights each return a typed refusal; nothing is clipped or repaired silently.

AS-5 (honesty + scope): class labels proposed / generated_option only (grep: no permitted/maximum-allowed wording); max_envelope.py and every route byte-untouched; zero new dependencies; ruff + modularity clean.
